method: Read-only proposal. Matched exact existing public-access SFA licence/address records to current first-party MOS Singapore outlet directory; read current operator menu category pages and cross-checked the 53 priced standard-menu rows already present for an exact MOS outlet. No workbook edits, delivery-platform sources, paid sources, Mapbox requests, or image downloads. Menu scope is brand-wide because operator does not verify per-outlet availability or dine-in/delivery price equivalence.
